title: Open an architecture defense
question: How do you open a two-minute architecture defense in English?
observableCriteria: The user problem and the main constraint are stated before any technical detail
The evidence and one limitation are announced up front rather than left to questions
modelAnswer: I state the user problem, the main constraint and the decision in plain language. Then I announce the evidence and one limitation before technical detail.
commonMistakes: Opening with the technical stack instead of the problem it was chosen for
variants: Changez une contrainte du scénario « Open an architecture defense » et expliquez si la décision reste valide.
